tagline: 理光胶片单反相机，1999 年发布
description: 理光于1999年推出的胶片单反相机。配备Ricoh 30mm F3.5 multicoated glass Lens,4 elements, 4 groups.。快门速度Programmed electronic shutter, 2 seconds ~ 1/750。感光度ISO 50-3200 (DX), ISO 100 for non-DX.。Passive type 7 zone multi point autofocusing with single AF facility. 0.35m - Infinity. Macro mode: 0.2m - 0.35m。
